alternative_hypothesis: H1: within a preregistered safe numerical envelope, accepted numerical controls change normalized final geometry by less than the registered tolerances, baseline trajectories plateau, generator/resolution comparisons converge, and export bytes are format-pinned and provenance-complete.
assumptions: KnotPlot relaxation is treated as a geometry-generation algorithm, not as evidence of physical SST self-confinement or particle stability.
Knot type is expected to be preserved only when collision constraints are active and step size is safely below the close-distance constraint.
dstep is a display cadence control and is preregistered as a negative-control parameter for geometry.
The preregistered same-topology dual-generator pair represents generator-family variants, not independent physical sources.
All gates G1-G8 are evaluated independently after G0 so an early FAIL does not suppress later diagnostics.
edge_cases: Missing KnotPlot output produces UNRESOLVED for data-dependent gates but does not suppress the remaining diagnostics.
A parameter that is demonstrably display-only is not interpreted as a dynamical degree of freedom.
Force-off cases are mechanism ablations and are not part of the accepted production numerical envelope.
Multi-component links may lack a well-defined single-component Procrustes comparison; scalar and component-safe metrics remain authoritative there.
Topology preservation and physical SST stability are distinct claims.

equations.dimensional_check: Coordinates are divided by RMS radius before comparison, so D_shape is dimensionless.
Ratio of equal-dimension quantities is dimensionless.
Length divided by length is dimensionless.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Historical scripts do not explicitly pin ASCII/raw export format for every production save.
dstep changes final normalized shape by more than 1e-8 or any scalar geometry metric by more than 1e-10 relative, indicating unexpected control contamination.
Within the accepted numerical envelope, median final scalar effect exceeds 1% or median D_shape exceeds 0.005 across qualified topologies.
Baseline 10k-to-15k scalar drift exceeds 1% or D_shape exceeds 0.005 for more than 20% of qualified topologies.
Resolution doubling fails to reduce error or final 600-to-1200 normalized effect exceeds 1% / D_shape exceeds 0.01 on the trefoil ladder.
Native C++ FP64 relative error for length, Rg or edge-CV exceeds 1e-12 on any certification curve.
Historical scripts rely on relaxation-relevant runtime defaults (charge, hooke, power, or timeincr) without explicitly pinning them or recording the KnotPlot build/runtime parameter state.

null_hypothesis: H0: the historical final geometries are materially dependent on undocumented or numerically arbitrary KnotPlot settings, fail plateau/resolution/generator robustness, or are not provenance-complete; therefore they do not qualify as canonical production exports.
objective: Separate topological identity from KnotPlot relaxation artefacts, quantify parameter sensitivity and relaxation/resolution convergence, and preregister the decision rule for whether a new canonical export generation is required.

observables.definition: Historical-script audit: script count, common parameter values, explicit save-format pinning, checkpoint count and topology/bead metadata.
KnotPlot checkpoint metrics: iteration, bead count, length, angle, ACN, linking number, safeness, radius of gyration and energy when available.
Normalized coordinate geometry diagnostics: D_shape, edge CV, normalized length and normalized radius of gyration.
Plateau and resolution convergence flags over the registered checkpoint and bead ladders.

predictions: dstep should be a strict null control for geometry.
Turning off one or more relaxation forces should generally alter relaxation trajectories, establishing that the pipeline is parameter-live rather than inert.
If the historical 15k endpoint is arbitrary rather than asymptotic, 10k-to-15k drift will remain measurable.
The preregistered same-topology dual-generator pair may converge under relaxation; failure to converge exposes generator-family dependence.
Regardless of geometric robustness, the historical scripts are expected to fail canonical provenance because save format is not explicitly pinned.
The historical scripts are expected to depend on unpinned relaxation defaults because charge, hooke, power and timeincr are not explicitly set.
research_question: Are KnotPlot-relaxed knot/link exports robust to the relaxation, force, discretization and export parameters used in the historical SST pipeline, and does the historical export protocol qualify as a canonical production geometry source?

steps.operation: Audit every uploaded historical .kpc file and hash the original source scripts.
Generate anonymous topology campaign scripts with explicitly pinned ASCII saves and per-checkpoint CSV metric capture.
Run dstep as a negative control and verify at least one genuine dynamics parameter is live.
Evaluate force ablations plus max-dr, close, bencon and stusplit perturbations without short-circuiting on prior failures.
Compare Python FP64 length/Rg/edge-CV against the pybind11 C++ FP64 implementation on exported coordinates.
Test 10k-to-15k relaxation plateau and trend against 4k-to-10k changes.
Test 0.5x/1x/2x/4x resolution response and same-topology dual-generator convergence.
Apply the frozen canonical-export qualification rule; any provenance defect is sufficient to reject the historical protocol as canonical while later scientific gates still run.

symbols.meaning: cyclic/reversal-aware orthogonal Procrustes RMS distance after centroid and RMS-radius normalization
relative change of scalar geometry observable m against the baseline condition
coefficient of variation of polygonal edge lengths
radius of gyration of exported vertices
